label: Instructional Item 1
stem: A group of friends decides to go out of town to a championship football game. The group pays $185 per ticket plus a one-time convenience fee of $15. They also each pay $27 to ride a tour bus to the game. If the group spent $2,771 in total, how many friends are in the group?

mustNotShow: the number that is the correct answer as a label
option letters A B C D
words that name the correct choice
